original: 死ぬまでに一度でいいからAV男優さんとエッチしてみたい。

en.text: I want to have sex with a male porn actor at least once before I die.

original: ケモナーであれば一度は全ての住人がファースーツを着て、外へ出掛ける世界を想像するでしょう！

en.text: If you are a furry then at least once you must have imagined a world you can leave into where every resident is wearing a fur suit.

original: 一度や二度失敗したくらいで諦めちゃだめだよ。

en.text: It is foolish to give up when have only failed once or twice.

original: 一度別れた彼とよりを戻したいと思っています。

en.text: I want to get back together with the boyfriend I broke up with.

original: トムって、一度話し始めるとなかなか止まんないのよ。

en.text: Once Tom starts talking, he's hard to stop.

original: その服まだ一度しか着てないのに捨てちゃうの？そんなもったいないことしちゃ駄目だよ。

en.text: You're throwing those clothes away even though you have only ever worn them once? You can't be so wasteful.

original: 「雪の彫刻」と言えば、「さっぽろ雪まつり」を思い出す。「さっぽろ雪まつり」一度は、行ってみたいな。

en.text: When you mentioned "snow carving", you reminded me of the "Sapporo snow festival". I'd love to go there one day.

original: ボストンには一度は行ってみるべし。

en.text: You should visit Boston at least once.
You ought to visit Boston.

original: 北海道には一度、行ったことがあります。

en.text: I have gone to Hokkaido one time.
I have gone to Hokkaido once.
I have been to Hokkaido one time.
I have been to Hokkaido once.

original: オーストラリアには一度、行ったことがあります。

en.text: I've been to Australia once.
I've been to Australia one time.

original: ３ヵ月に一度、トムに会います。

en.text: I meet Tom once every three months.

original: お父様には一度お会いしたことがあるんです。

en.text: I met your father once.

original: 僕は一度テレビに出た覚えがある。

en.text: I remember coming out on TV one time.

original: 今朝の最低気温は、－１度。日中でも７度までしか上がりません。あたたかくしてお出かけください。

en.text: This morning's low temperature was -1 degree. The temperature will only go up to 7 degrees during the day. Please dress warmly when you go out.

original: どんなに子供が好きでも、子育てを放棄したくなる時が一度や二度はあるんじゃないかな。

en.text: Every parent probably has that moment where they want to just stop being one, no matter how much they love their kid.

original: 香港には一度行ったことがありますよ。

en.text: I've been to Hong Kong once.

original: 彼に一度会ってるよ。

en.text: I met him once.

original: 一度でも勝てると自信がついていいんだけれどね。

en.text: Winning even once would be good for their self-confidence, right?

original: 月に一度、床屋に行きます。

en.text: Once a month, I go to the barber.
I go to the barber once a month.
I go to the barber's once a month.

original: １度しか言わないから、よく聞け。

en.text: I will only say it once, so listen carefully.
I won't repeat this, so listen carefully.

original: 精肉店と飲食店を兼ねたお店だからこそできるこの低価格。ぜひ一度ご賞味ください。

en.text: Because we're both a butcher's shop and a restaurant, we can offer such low prices. Please have a taste!

original: 煮物は一度冷ますと、味が染みこみ美味しくなります。

en.text: If you give simmered food a moment to cool, the flavors will spread throughout the dish, and it'll taste really good.

original: 人を殺したり怪我を負わせたりしたことなど一度たりともありません。

en.text: I have never killed nor injured anybody.
I've never killed nor injured anyone.
I've never killed nor injured anybody.

original: 髪は月に一度切るよ。

en.text: I have my hair cut once a month.
I get my hair cut once a month.
I get a haircut once a month.

original: ボストンには一度しか行ったことがない。

en.text: I've only been to Boston once.
I've only been to Boston one time.

original: この作家の文体は独特で、一度読んだら忘れられない。

en.text: This author's writing style is unique; once you read it, you'll never forget.
